attributes.name: Elder Fire Demon
attributes.powers:
The Elder Fire Demon is immune to the Electricity, Fire, and Poison traits. All damage dealt by the Elder Fire Demon is Fire damage. If you succeed at an Intelligence or Knowledge 18 check, add 10 to your check to defeat it.

If undefeated, expend 1d4 mythic charges.

If defeated, each character at your location rolls 1d20; if a character rolls a number less than or equal to her hand size, she discards her hand.
